docs.text: West Michigan: Here’s our group gathered together in Muskegon, MI this past week to spell out the word “RESIST” in the sand next to Lake Michigan. If you are close, we would love for you to join us!! We have in-person meetings, events, and other ways for you to get involved! .org

Most recently, 6th graders have been visiting Muskegon State Park & the Muskegon Luge to learn about the habitats in Western Michigan & prototype luge designs! Many of these students live just miles from Lake Michigan & had never actually been to the lake before, let alone ridden a luge!

🍂 Fall colors and Muskegon history come together at The Muskegon Blockhouse. Located on Scenic Drive in Muskegon State Park, this historic replica of Fort Dearborn offers panoramic views of Lake Michigan and fall foliage. Learn more: www.visitmuskegon.org/listing/blockhouse-the/391/

All hands on deck! Muskegon Public Schools students boarded the #WGJackson for a research cruise and experiential learning on Muskegon Lake and Lake Michigan. Students took observational and analytical water samples and learned about our local waterways. 🔬 #FutureScientists
